name: Striver’s A2Z DSA Sheet
description:
Learn data structures and algorithms in a clear sequence, from programming foundations to advanced problems.
Build your coding interview skills through independent practice, better approaches, and regular revision.

name: Striver’s 75 – India’s Blind 75 Alternative
description:
Revisit core DSA patterns with a focused set of questions for coding interviews and placements.
Practise choosing an approach, explaining its complexity, and solving difficult problems independently.

description:
Build your approach to coding interviews with 150 DSA questions organised by topic and problem-solving pattern.
Learn when a technique applies, compare related problems, and practise adapting your solution to new constraints.
